what: Every preregistered result in this repository that went AGAINST its own thesis, enumerated so a reviewer can count them. Each entry names the VERDICT.md row and the artifact.
thesis: per-tenant adaptation of a small open model beats prompting for private document extraction

results.finding: the cheapest hosted API tier beats the adapted 0.5B on every run (0W/14L/16T to 1W/13L/16T)
a bare field list takes the hosted tier to 0.8930 — the cost argument's premise fails
the 1.5B 'cannot produce a usable object' result was a markdown fence; withdrawn in place
an unadapted 3B on a 196-token prompt matches the adapted 0.5B (0.8958 vs 0.8833)
at matched batching the quality tolerance breaks; no cost ratio is citable
adaptation at 3B loses to twenty demonstrations (D=-0.0390)
four rungs fail the frozen two-statistics bar; E5 by one win; E6 dead flat on CORD
three architectures clear the mean tolerance and never separate by sign test against the best prompting available; order-robustness is what survives
